left_target_basis: 2026-11-18 grasp-execution-20261118-40 success, eraser centre (375.0, 148.2) mm, extended posture; single success, not a validated region
wheel_raw_basis: s4_base.command-candidate.json pattern L [-100,-100,200] scaled to s4_unified.policy.json maximum_wheel_speed_raw 100; fourth value is the unused lift channel as in the commissioning base pulse
speed_basis: half of the raw-200 lidar median strafe speeds in s4_base.command-candidate.json (L 0.01347, R 0.01445 m/s); linear scaling and the raw-100 deadband are unmeasured. Replace with the field value from two top-inspect captures before and after a timed move.
limitations: Open-loop timed strafe; the next top-inspect is the measurement of the actual shift.
Ends with whole-system STOP; the unified firmware requires a fresh controller reset before arm use.
